script.problem: It copies Smith's Bible Dictionary: "a river in the land of the chaldeans". Write it in your own words.

terra.problem: The line calls these Ezekiel’s first visions, but Ezekiel 1:1-3 does not say they were his first. Remove “first.”
“Glory on the plain” happens on a plain, not at a location identified as the River Kebar. It recalls the glory Ezekiel saw by the river (Ezekiel 3:22-23).
“Living creatures were cherubim” describes a later vision at the temple, not an event by the River Kebar. Ezekiel recalls the creatures he saw by the river (Ezekiel 10:18-22).
“The glory returns” describes a vision at the temple, not an event by the River Kebar. Ezekiel compares it with his earlier visions by the river (Ezekiel 43:2-5).
